verdict.rationale: gstack ships its skills as SKILL.md folders, which is the Agent Skills file convention. Its docs say the skills run on many agent hosts (Claude, Codex, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Cursor and others), so the skills are clearly usable beyond one vendor. However, that portability comes from a per-host generator built on typed TypeScript configs, not from documented conformance to the open spec, so a single unmodified folder being valid everywhere is not evidenced. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of Agent Skills specification compliance, evidence that the frontmatter and folder structure follow the spec, evidence that the same folder works unchanged across hosts without the generator, and independent corroboration.
